description: React component for a personalized response form allowing users to set preferences such as expertise, goal, about, and special instructions, with integration for API calls, validation, and UI elements.

classes.name: PersonalizedResponseForm
classes.description: React memoized functional component for managing user preferences form in a modal.

methods.name: getInitialGoalSelection
methods.description: Determines initial goal selection based on default values.

methods.name: handleGoalSelectionChange
methods.description: Handles change in goal selection, focusing textarea if 'Other' is selected.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, including login check and API call to set preferences.
